people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh says, “The people who survive the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.”
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD says: “The people who survived the sword found favor in the wilderness when Israel went to find rest.”
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah, The people that were left of the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
